name: Lancelot
source:
The leader of the Knights of the Round Table, a man called the Strongest of Knights. He looks aloof at first glance, yet is calm and thoughtful. He is there to support the heroine when she gets a bumpy start to her life at the castle.

He keeps his left arm bandaged, but it doesn't seem to be due to any wound. He wouldn't let anyone see beneath the bandages.

"With this...I can always carry on winning for your sake."

[From in-game profile]
